name: Reference preset shapes a source-grounded study pack
steps: Choose Ninja Nerd in Reference Lab
expected: The selected teaching profile is visible and factual content still comes from official/source material.

name: Import a public website or YouTube reference
steps: Paste a readable public education URL
expected: A high-level teaching profile is shown without copied scripts or proprietary questions.

name: Forge Tutor uses current study context
steps: Choose What should I study next?
expected: Forge Tutor returns an exam-oriented answer using available guide/QBank/weak-topic context.

name: Exam Coach still grades attempts
expected: Score and missed subtopics are visible.

name: Reference Lab and copilot fit mobile
expected: No horizontal overflow and the copilot is usable as an overlay.
